title: Your most dated section may earn clicks
body: For anyone refreshing old blog posts, on their own site or for clients.

title: Trim whatever reads old
body: An old year, tool or price. Cutting it feels like cleanup.

title: Dated sections can still answer real queries
body: Cut them and their traffic leaves with them.

title: Export the page's queries
body: In Search Console, filter the Performance report to this one page.

title: Sort them by impressions
body: The top of the list shows what the page is really found for.

title: Ctrl+F each query's main words
body: Find the section that answers it and note its heading.

title: Label every section
body: "Earns traffic" or "no queries found." Only the second kind goes.

title: Wait, then compare
body: If clicks drop, restore the sections you cut first.

title: Pick one post due a refresh
body: Pull its queries and label each section before editing anything.
